findings.what:
L5 STRUCTURE: once probes 39 (exp70e = lp30+dc0.30), 40 (exp70a = lp30), 41 (exp70d = dc0.30) and 42 (exp70b = fm45, 00:05Z) have scored, the only UNSCORED combinations of {lp30, dc0.30, fm45} are lp30+fm45 (exp70c), dc0.30+fm45 (exp70h) and lp30+dc0.30+fm45 (exp70f). Every one contains fm45. So the whole informed-combo stage depends on probe 42 reading POSITIVE, and at most ONE combo rung exists.
PRE-REGISTERED RULE L5v2 (log it before 04:37Z, when probe 39 can first score):
(1) UNIT STATUS for each scored probe p in {a, d, e, b}. POS = display >= 0.955, or display 0.954 with an attributable UP event (R13L-2). NEG = display <= 0.953. NEU = otherwise, including an UP that cannot be attributed and any 'no move' after the team best was already raised by another ladder probe.
(2) KNOB STATUS. lp30 comes from a, dc0.30 from d, fm45 from b. A knob is NEG if its single is NEG. If e is NEG while neither a nor d is NEG, both lp30 and dc0.30 are BLOCKED for any combo (the interaction cannot be split).
(3) BASE for the fm45 combo = the best-known POS unit among a, d and e that holds no NEG or BLOCKED knob. Order: higher display; then the unit whose attributable UP came last (it beat every earlier one); then class A; then fewer knobs. If two units are tied because of a co-completion ambiguity, take the one with fewer knobs.
(4) COMBO = BASE + fm45, and only if fm45 is POS. BASE a -> exp70c, BASE d -> exp70h, BASE e -> exp70f. With no POS base there is no combo, because fm45 alone is already scored.
(5) No other rung: no threshold neighbours (I-310), no class C, no cap6 (its lab arm is negative on both embryos), and NEU knobs are never combined.
MAIN PATTERNS (e, a, d displays; then 42):
(i) 0.954/0.954/0.954 with no attributable UP (prior ~0.55-0.65): no POS base -> no combo whatever 42 shows. The ladder ends at 42. V* only if 42 displays >= 0.955 (then {exp70b, #38} under L9).
(ii) Only a UP (lp30 POS): V* none; see R13L-3 for the 0.954 extension; if 42 is POS -> exp70c.
(iii) e UP first (e POS, a/d NEU by order): if 42 is POS -> exp70f.
(iv) Only d UP: if 42 is POS -> exp70h.
(v) Any display >= 0.955: that probe is POS; V* by L9 (each single >= 0.954; ties A > fewer knobs > earlier); the combo follows (3)-(4).
(vi) d = 0.953: dc0.30 NEG, so exp70e, exp70f and exp70h are excluded even if e shows 0.955 (L9 (2)).
(vii) a = 0.953: lp30 NEG, so exp70c and exp70f are excluded.
(viii) e = 0.953 with a, d >= 0.954: lp30 and dc0.30 are BLOCKED, so no combo.
(ix) 42 = 0.953: fm45 NEG, so no combo; the ladder ends.
PRIORS: P(any POS base) ~0.3-0.4. P(fm45 POS) ~0.08-0.15, lower still after a raised team best, because exp70b must then beat it. So P(a combo rung is submitted) ~0.03-0.06. Given a submit, it adds ~+0.0001..+0.0004 over the team best if additive, with P(display 0.955) ~0.3.

findings.what:
ATTRIBUTION OF A PUBLIC MOVE (pre-register with L5v2; it closes round-13 plancheck PC13-03).
(a) PASSED-TEAM RULE. S0 = an LB download taken right before the event. A0 = the TeamIds ranked above us in S0. S1 = the download after the event. The event is UP iff some team in A0 is ranked BELOW us in S1. Public bests never decrease, so this proves our best rose. It is immune to other teams' moves and entrants; a merged or deleted team is absent, not 'below'. Record the number of passed teams as info only.
(b) FRESHNESS. Our LB row's LastSubmissionDate is the submit time of our latest SCORED submission: at 22:46Z it read 00:02:18 = #38 while 39-41 were PENDING. S1 is valid only if that field equals the submit time of the newest-submitted COMPLETE probe (21:15:23 / 21:17:47 / 21:38:33 / 00:05). If it is stale, re-download after 2 min, up to 3 times; after that the event is AMBIGUOUS. Verify the field's semantics at the first event; if it does not move, fall back to poll.log times.
(c) WINDOWS. poll.log polls every 600 s (lb_poll.py), and probes 39 and 40 were submitted 2.4 min apart (expected COMPLETE 04:37-04:50Z), so co-completion in one 10-min window is likely. Run a read-only 2-min ListSubmissions watcher from 04:25 to 05:30Z (39-41; 41 is expected 05:00-05:11Z) and from 07:15 to 07:50Z (42, expected 07:27-07:38Z). Take one LB download at 04:25Z and at 07:15Z (S0), then one at each status change (S1). That is ~45 extra ListSubmissions calls plus ~5 downloads. The main session is the only Kaggle API user in those windows (R12-A5); on a 429, back off 60 s. poll.log stays the official record for L9 (display and COMPLETE).
(d) CO-COMPLETION. If two probes change status between S0 and S1: a probe displaying higher than the other takes the UP; if both display the same, the UP is NON-ATTRIBUTABLE and both are NEU. There is no 'common-knob credit': max(e, a) > B0 can come from dc0.30 alone.
(e) ORDER. After an UP, later probes register UP only if they beat the NEW best, so their 'no move' is NEU, not evidence against their knob. The same applies to exp70b at 07:30Z whenever a, d or e raised the best.
(f) SENSITIVITY (estimate; assumes a uniform 0.954 block): 100 teams in <= 0.001, and we are 15th (rank 229 at 22:46Z), so B0 ~0.95436. Passing the next team needs ~+1e-5; a display flip to 0.955 needs ~+0.00014. UP therefore reads close to the sign of (probe - B0), where B0 = max(P36, #35, K2), not K2.
